features.name: Increased Forge Points Storage
features.description: Store more Forge Points than usual.
features.tooltip: While this package is active, your Forge Points limit is increased 10 times! After the package expires, you keep all overflowing FP.

features.name: Collect All for Free
features.description: Collect all incidents and finished production in your city for free.
features.tooltip: While this package is active collect and restart all your finished production buildings in your city and exclusively collect all available incidents at once for free.

features.name: Town Hall Boosts
features.description: Additional attack and defense for your armies.
features.tooltip: While this package is active, you gain additional attack and defense for both your armies. 15% for your attacking and 15% for your defending army.

features.name: Reward Delivery
features.description: Get additional Rewards once per week!
features.tooltip: Get additional Rewards once per week! 50 Goods, 10 Forge Points

rewards.name: 50 Goods
rewards.description: 10 of each good from your age!

rewards.name: 10 Forge Points
rewards.description: Use Forge Points to research technologies or contribute them to Great Buildings.

features.name: Exclusive Timer
features.description: Get an additional exclusive timer in the Antiques Dealer.
features.tooltip: While this package is active, you can exchange items with an additional exclusive Timer in the Antiques Dealer.

features.name: Refresh The Shop
features.description: The first shuffle of the Antiques Dealer shop is free.
features.tooltip: While this package is active once per day, the first shuffle of the Antiques Dealer shop is free.

features.name: Emissary Double Production
features.description: The first 2 assigned Emissaries produce double.
features.tooltip: While this package is active, the first 2 assigned Emissaries in the Town Hall do produce double.

features.name: New Avatar Frame
features.tooltip: While this package is active, you get a new frame in the social bar everyone can see. You can disable the visibility in the options.

features.name: Remove ads
features.tooltip: While this package is active, no video ads will be shown.
